title: Interest Accrual and Crediting on Savings and Money Market Accounts
content:
### Accrual and crediting

Interest on Savings & Money Market Accounts accrues daily on each calendar day's end-of-day balance and is credited on the cycle closing date as separate interest credit entries, one for each component that stands above 0.00 USD after rounding. A day whose end-of-day balance is below the tier's minimum balance to earn interest earns no interest of any component.

Base interest uses the tier's base annual percentage yield ladder under the band method that tier carries. The tier and the ladder used for each day are those in force on that day. The day count basis for this product is 365 days, and that figure remains in force.

### How the components stack

The stacking of the components is fixed. On the promotional portion of a day's balance the promotional annual percentage yield replaces the base yield, and neither the relationship bonus nor the goal bonus is added to it. On the remaining balance the base yield applies, and the relationship bonus and the goal bonus each add their own percentage points.

A component that does not apply to an account is not applicable rather than zero-rated, and writes no entry.

### No longer in force

The clause that stated how each day's interest was worked out from the day's balance, the annual percentage yield and the day count basis, and that summed the daily amounts unrounded for each component before rounding each component total half up to the cent, is no longer in force. It has been superseded, and it is not to be applied to any account of this product. The day count basis itself, given above, is unaffected.

### Interest at closure

Interest accrued since the last cycle close is paid when the account closes mid-cycle only on a tier whose accrued interest parameter reads yes; on a tier where it reads no, that accrued interest is forfeited.

### Correcting a past cycle

A correction for interest under-credited in a past cycle is written as a separate entry, on the bank error ground, for the same statement cycle and the same component, and for the difference only.

superseded_clauses: Each day's interest is balance times APY divided by 100 and by interest_day_count_basis; daily amounts are summed unrounded per component and each component total is rounded half-up to the cent.
